  - region "Simple English explanation of Scalar Multiplication":
    - paragraph: In simple English
    - heading "Understand Scalar Multiplication" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "Scalar multiplication scales length and may reverse direction. 3<2,1>=<6,3> and −1<2,1>=<−2,−1>. The direction stays the same when the scalar is positive. A useful rule is Scalar Multiplication: kv=(kvx,kvy). You can learn Scalar Multiplication by trying one small example instead of long theory."
    - paragraph: "Multiply every component by the scalar and keep the sign of the scalar as the direction flag. Example: Find 3(2,-1). Multiply x by 3. Multiply y by 3. So the answer is (6,-3)."
    - paragraph: "In real life, speed: Doubling velocity doubles each component. Watch out: Multiplying only one component. Scale every component."
    - complementary:
      - generic: Try this example
      - paragraph: Find 3(2,-1).
      - generic "Compare your answer"
